title: LLM-Augmented Agent-Based Simulation of Cyber Social Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.32988v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Social media bots are often portrayed as malicious automations to be detected and removed, but automation on social media platforms encompasses a wide spectrum of roles, behaviors, and rhetorical strategies that can shape online discourse in both constructive and destructive ways. This work conceptualizes these automated actors as \textbf{Cyber Social Agents} through a taxonomy of archetypes characterized by their operational tactics and rhetorical style. We integrate this taxonomy into an LLM-driven social simulation, where agents communicate and coordinate in a network environment. Using empirically grounded CSA personas, we simulate heterogeneous online societies to study how agent diversity shapes information diffusion and social influence. Our approach bridges the gap between rule-based agent models and LLM-powered simulations with generated agents that are parameterized from empirical data.

translated_title: 基于大语言模型增强的网络社会智能体仿真
translated_abstract: 社交媒体机器人通常被描绘为需要被检测和清除的恶意自动化程序，但社交媒体平台上的自动化实际上涵盖了广泛的角色、行为和修辞策略，它们能够以建设性或破坏性的方式塑造在线话语。本工作通过一个以操作策略和修辞风格为特征的原型分类体系，将这些自动化行为者概念化为“网络社会智能体”。我们将该分类体系集成到一个由大语言模型驱动的社交仿真中，其中智能体在网络环境中进行交流与协调。利用基于实证数据构建的CSA角色设定，我们模拟了异构的在线社会，以研究智能体多样性如何塑造信息传播和社会影响力。我们的方法通过基于实证数据参数化生成的智能体，弥合了基于规则的智能体模型与大语言模型驱动仿真之间的鸿沟。
tldr: 该论文提出“网络社会智能体”分类体系，并将其融入大语言模型驱动的社交仿真中，通过实证数据参数化生成异构智能体来研究智能体多样性对信息传播与社会影响的作用，从而弥合了规则驱动模型与LLM驱动仿真之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This work introduces a taxonomy of "Cyber Social Agents" integrated into an LLM-driven social simulation, using empirically parameterized heterogeneous agents to study how agent diversity shapes information diffusion and social influence, bridging the gap between rule-based agent models and LLM-powered simulations.
